FDXF.why: Results for the four months to September showed revenue up 9.3% to $3.3bn, and analysts backed its medium-term targets; its biggest one-day rise.

REGN.why: Third-quarter earnings beat, lifted by Eylea HD sales and its share of Sanofi's Dupixent profits.

BTSG.why: Moved on its third-quarter results, released that morning.

GDDY.why: Third-quarter revenue of $1.34bn and adjusted earnings of $2.08 a share; it has bought back 15.7 million shares this year.

RDDT.why: Beat third-quarter forecasts but guided fourth-quarter revenue below them, and plans to make users register to read its forums.

INTC.why: Guided fourth-quarter revenue to $15bn-$16bn against about $17.1bn expected, citing an Israel plant shutdown and weak PC demand; its worst day since the 1970s.

ILMN.why: Third-quarter revenue of $1.13bn missed despite an earnings beat and raised guidance; JPMorgan cut its target to $300.

RBLX.why: Forecast fourth-quarter bookings 10%-15% below a year earlier, and daily users fell 9%.

TWLO.why: Beat third-quarter forecasts, but its fourth-quarter outlook of 11%-12% organic growth disappointed.

IDXX.why: Third-quarter results beat estimates and the outlook was raised.

NXT.why: Quarterly results beat estimates and guidance was raised.

TEM.why: Third-quarter results beat estimates and the 2026 revenue outlook was raised.

RIVN.why: UBS upgraded the stock to Buy and the quarterly loss narrowed to $0.48 a share from $0.65.

LITE.why: Fell with chip stocks in Thursday's AI sell-off, the semiconductor index's worst day since March 2020.

MRVL.why: Fell on its all-stock agreement to buy Lumentum for about $115bn, on concerns over size, dilution and the long closing timeline.

CBRS.why: UBS cut its price target to $250 from $330 and kept a Buy rating; a short-seller report and a share lock-up expiry were also cited.

FN.why: Reported fiscal first-quarter results on 3 November; headlines cite record results alongside margin pressure.

NBIX.why: Reported third-quarter results on 3 November; the move followed the earnings release (headline only, details not checked).

FISV.why: Third-quarter adjusted profit of $1.75 a share beat the $1.72 expected, the cost-savings target was doubled to $1bn and a $500m buyback resumes in the fourth quarter; revenue fell 1%.

RRX.why: Reported third-quarter results on 3 November with organic growth accelerating, per an earnings-call summary.

INIO.why: J.P. Morgan and Citi cut targets amid worries over data-center permitting; a lock-up ends November 30.

DT.why: Fell about 15% after trimming its earnings guidance and starting a share buyback.

IT.why: Revenue of $1.505bn beat estimates but fell 1.3% from a year earlier, despite a raised 2026 outlook; investors appear to have focused on the shrinking top line.

TRI.why: Third-quarter revenue of $1.83bn and adjusted earnings of $0.81 a share missed estimates of $1.91bn and $0.89, though it raised its 2026 revenue growth forecast to 9.5%.

ZBRA.why: Reported results with a raised outlook, yet the shares fell 8.8% (headline only).

PCOR.why: Reported third-quarter results with revenue growth accelerating, per a Yahoo Finance earnings-call summary.

MDLN.why: Beat third-quarter estimates, raised its sales outlook and announced a $1bn buyback, per TIKR.

XYZ.why: Reported results that TipRanks describes as record profitability and growth.

FIS.why: Issued third-quarter results on 4 November, per MarketBeat; the stock fell sharply.

UNM.why: Reported a third-quarter loss of $419.7m amid an SEC matter, per Pluang.

MTZ.why: Fell after third-quarter results despite a record backlog; Jefferies cut its price target to $353.

SNDK.why: Memory makers rebounded after CoreWeave's results; Sandisk had lost more than 22% on November 5.

ALAB.why: Fell with chip stocks in Thursday's AI sell-off, the semiconductor index's worst day since March 2020.

MTSI.why: Fell with chip stocks in Thursday's AI sell-off, the semiconductor index's worst day since March 2020.

CRDO.why: Fell with chip stocks in Thursday's AI sell-off, the semiconductor index's worst day since March 2020.

TPR.why: Fiscal first-quarter adjusted EPS of $1.82 beat $1.56 expected, Coach sales rose 16%, and fiscal 2027 EPS guidance was raised to $8.25-$8.35.

APP.why: Jumped after its third-quarter results on Wednesday evening (the after-hours surge was reported by CNBC); details not checked.

FROG.why: Third-quarter cloud revenue rose 60% and it raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $680–682m.

IONQ.why: Third-quarter revenue of $173.8m beat forecasts of $141.5m and it raised its 2026 outlook to $505–515m.

SITM.why: Seaport Global upgraded it to Buy with a $425 target after a roughly 50% fall from its September peak.

UI.why: Quarterly EPS of $5.32 beat forecasts of $4.25 on revenue of $1.03bn.

AXON.why: Third-quarter revenue rose 28% to $908.6m, but it guided 2026 free cash flow to $350–400m and flagged memory costs.

TEAM.why: Revenue rose 24% to $1.77bn, but it guided fiscal 2027 growth to about 13.75% with Data Center sales shrinking about 16%.

HALO.why: Third-quarter revenue rose 39% to $493m, beating forecasts, but its raised 2026 sales outlook disappointed.

NTRA.why: Fell after third-quarter results (revenue up 34% to $794m, outlook raised) and a CEO change to Solomon Moshkevich.

MCHP.why: Guided December-quarter revenue from −3% to +1%, below forecasts, and analysts cut targets.

QXO.why: Preliminary third-quarter sales rose 79% to $4.9bn and its loss narrowed to $123m.

COHR.why: Rebounded with AI optics stocks; no company news, TIKR reported.

CHTR.why: Offered to buy back up to $1.5bn of long-dated notes trading below face value.

TTWO.why: GTA VI preorders topped 7 million and it kept its fiscal-2027 bookings guidance.

PS.why: Third-quarter loss of $19.9m with no performance fees, against a $155.5m profit a year earlier.

SKYD.why: Warned weak Warner Bros. films would cut about $200m from fourth-quarter adjusted earnings.

GFL.why: The board ended its review of take-private bids, choosing to stay public.

CRWV.why: Third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66bn and it raised its 2026 revenue outlook to up to $13.3bn.

NBIS.why: Cut its 2026 revenue outlook to $3.0–3.2bn and raised capex to about $27bn with a wider third-quarter loss.

MU.why: Memory makers rebounded after CoreWeave's results; Micron had fallen about 17.5% on November 5.

AVGO.why: Rivals rose as Nvidia's chief executive resigned.
